description: Runs the BAS readiness checks for one client and one BAS period, reading Xero through the Xero API connector, and returns the findings, what came back clear, what could not run, the ABNs to check with ABR Lookup, and the limitations. Read-only: nothing in Xero is changed. The Client Reporting Agent runs it during a BAS readiness review.
